subtitle: Manage governed documents and repository sources used for FDAI knowledge.
sourcesHint: Open a source to upload content or review its connection boundary. Credentials and repository authorization remain in Integration settings.
documentsSummary: Upload files through quarantine, protection checks, extraction, and indexing.
githubSummary: Connect and verify a read-only GitHub source. Code-security scan permission stays separate.
githubPurpose: Verify a repository knowledge source without enabling code-security scans.
githubBoundary: A verified connection records repository, commit, and README provenance. It does not mean content is indexed or authorize scans.
githubUnavailable: The authoritative GitHub connection ledger is unavailable. Refresh to retry.
githubGaps: Some repository records were withheld because their evidence is invalid or incomplete.
githubCredentialHint: Credentials stay in deployment-owned secret storage. Private repositories require the existing read-only GitHub App identity. Do not enter keys or tokens.
githubOwnerOnly: Only an authenticated Owner can change knowledge connections.
githubQueued: Connection request queued, not yet verified. Refresh to read the applied state; request outcomes are available in Code security.
githubForbidden: Owner authority is required. Refresh authoritative state before another request.
githubFailed: The request could not be confirmed. Refresh authoritative state before another request.
gitlabSummary: Prepare a governed GitLab project connection and define its synchronization scope.
azureDevopsSummary: Prepare a governed Azure DevOps repository connection and define its synchronization scope.
connectorSubtitle: Review the governed connection boundary for {provider} knowledge.
connectorUnavailableBody: This deployment does not expose a server-owned {provider} connector contract yet. No repository content has been synchronized or indexed from this source.
connectorBoundary: Repository credentials, organization access, path scope, synchronization policy, and secret storage must be configured through a server-owned integration. The browser never stores provider credentials.
unsupportedFileFormat: This file format is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, a supported text file, or a supported image.
legacyOfficeFormat: Legacy DOC, PPT, and XLS files are not supported. Save them as DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or PDF first.
readyWithWarnings: Ready with processing warnings. Review the document metadata before relying on image-derived content.
formatSignatureMismatch: The file content does not match its filename extension or media type.
malformedPackage: The Office or PDF package is malformed and could not be processed safely.
ocrUnavailable: OCR is required for this document, but the configured OCR provider is unavailable.
noExtractableContent: No cited text could be extracted from this document.
encryptedDocument: This encrypted or protected document cannot be read with the current authorization.
ocrUnavailableHint: Image-only uploads are unavailable because OCR is not configured. Images embedded in Office documents are reported as processing warnings.
viewPurpose: A source-oriented view of governed knowledge intake without inferring unobserved connection state.
connectorViewPurpose: The explicit {provider} knowledge-source boundary and its current setup availability.
collectionHint: Collections are governed namespaces, not folders. Use an existing collection ID; policy controls creation, access, renaming, and moves.
libraryHint: One row per file. Open version history to preview, download, or delete an exact immutable version.
libraryEmpty: No documents are visible in this collection.
collectionsHint: Collections are governed top-level folders. Access and retention are policy-controlled.
previewUnavailable: Preview becomes available after indexing and authorization checks.
downloadUnavailable: Download requires an indexed, available, unprotected source.
deleteUnavailable: Deletion requires uploader or Owner authority and no legal hold.
deleteConfirm: Delete this version and its indexed content?
unchangedUpload: No content or policy changes were detected. The existing version was kept.
noMatches: No documents match the current search and filter.
dispositionHintKnowledge: Reusable collection knowledge. Retention and access follow collection policy.
dispositionHintDraft: Short-lived draft for testing or review. Promote it explicitly before expiry.
promoteConfirm: Add this document to governed knowledge in {collection}?
